name: minigraf_audit
description: Audit all graph entities against the built-in schema. Retracts entities with schema violations (missing required attributes, unknown types, unknown attributes). Run periodically or after heavy write sessions. Pass as_of (transaction number) for a read-only point-in-time audit without retractions.

as_of.description: Optional transaction number for point-in-time audit (read-only, no retractions)
